title: Fra Giovanni di Lucca to Ferdinand III, 30 May 1644 (DECODE R2159, ÖStA HHStA Staatskanzlei Interiora, Chiffrenschlüssel Kt. 20 Fasc. 27 ff. 18-19)

documents.shelfmark: ÖStA HHStA Staatskanzlei Interiora, Chiffrenschlüssel Kt. 20 Fasc. 27 ff. 18-19 (DECODE R2159)

plaintext.source: Tomokiyo gave only 'Al principe di trenti...'; DECODE lists it non-decrypted.

transcription.notes: DECODE images need a login and were not seen; 17 = n and 19 = s might be misread 14 and another figure.

system.summary: 24-figure Italian alphabet in dot-delimited 1-2 digit groups, a few homophones and two polyphonic figures (17 = i/n, 19 = t/s).
system.doubled_letters: written once (one doubled pair in 231 groups)
system.notes: i has 15 and shares 17 with n; s only through 19.

prior_solution.where: Tomokiyo's unsolved page: opening 'Al principe di trenti...' only

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Unconstrained homophonic annealing, 16 restarts; converges on a non-Italian optimum.
Tomokiyo's crib 'Al principe di' taken literally needs 17 = i and n.
Eight consistent crib letters fixed, other 16 figures annealed; all six seeds agree on Italian.
Polyphony 17 = i/n, 19 = t/s read off the contexts.
Same procedure on five shufflings scores -3.40 to -3.68 per 5-gram against -2.50.
Viterbi over the alternatives reads all 231 groups; two spots ambiguous.

outcome.notes: Odd spellings ogn, Bogodania, Transiuania and io/no il habi rest on an unchecked transcription.
